import boto3
cw = boto3.client('cloudwatch')
cw.put_metric_alarm(
    AlarmName='{{alarm_name}}',
    ComparisonOperator='GreaterThanThreshold',
    EvaluationPeriods=3,
    MetricName='CPUUtilization',
    Namespace='AWS/EC2',
    Period=60,
    Statistic='Average',
    Threshold={{threshold}},
    Dimensions=[{'Name':'InstanceId','Value':'{{instance_id}}'}],
    AlarmActions=[],
)
